change: PcmAudio.observed returns a monitored asset and receiver; each decoder has a distinct local identity even for cloned assets.
Decoder emits Created, Exhausted, Seek with clamped frame and Dropped with exhaustion state. Read-ahead does not manufacture early exhaustion; repeated EOF does not duplicate it.
Notifications survive audio-thread execution; disconnected receiver is harmless.

tests.scope: Three lifecycle tests plus eight existing PCM/media/dispatch/seek tests.

limits: Observed transport is opt-in; actual game voice admission/worker adapter and callback consumer are still to connect.
Exhausted means source data consumed, not completion of hardware output or native EndOfEvent; Bevy/Rodio buffering and repeat wrappers must be accounted for before scratch retirement.
No normal client build or audible runtime acceptance this turn.
